nodes.description: External caller address; attacker-controllable and used for owner checks, allowance bookkeeping and delegatecall gating.
Privileged owner address, set to the deployer; used as the whitelist bypass key in ensure and as the access gate in privileged functions.
Whitelisted trade address; _from == tradeAddress bypasses the sale-condition checks in ensure.
Public balance mapping mutated with unchecked += / -= arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public allowance mapping mutated with unchecked -= arithmetic in transferFrom.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Per-address whitelist flag that bypasses ensure conditions.
Minimum sale amount, computed with unchecked multiplication in init.
Maximum sale amount, computed with unchecked multiplication in init.
Global sale cap, set in init and compared in condition.
Total token supply written in the constructor.
Token name set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant decimal scale (18) used for supply and sale-limit scaling.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core transfer path: debits allowance and balances with unchecked subtraction, credits recipient with unchecked addition and calls ensure.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] to an arbitrary value.
Whitelist gate: allows transfers when _from/_to is owner, UNI, the derived pair or tradeAddress, otherwise enforces condition().
Validates sale-count and min/max sale limits read from storage.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only configuration of _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale with unchecked scaling arithmetic.
Owner-only loop that mass-transfers tokens using unchecked multiplication and subtraction.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Pure Uniswap-V2 pair address derivation used by ensure.
Deployment routine that mints the supply to msg.sender and sets owner and an unlimited UNI allowance.
Low-level delegatecall to an attacker/owner supplied address executed in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked subtraction of a user-supplied amount from a balances entry; underflows without SafeMath.
Unchecked addition to a recipient balances entry; can overflow without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction from the caller allowance mapping; underflow risk.
Unchecked subtraction of the batch total from the caller balance.
Unchecked multiplication of a user-supplied value by an unbounded array length; overflow risk.
Unchecked scaling multiplication when deriving sale limits in init.

Calldata bytes parameter of delegate passed into delegatecall.
Sale-count parameter of init.

Maximum sale token parameter of init, used in unchecked scaling.
Recipient array parameter of batchSend; its length multiplies the value.
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.
Token name constructor argument.
Token symbol constructor argument.
Initial supply constructor argument, scaled by decimals.
Local variable holding _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop index of the batchSend recipient loop.
Per-iteration recipient local in batchSend.

init gates configuration on require(msg.sender == owner).

setTradeAddress gates whitelist mutation on require(msg.sender == owner).

batchSend executes the unchecked subtraction of the batch total.
